body:
PR Summary by Qodo

Add Save all for received files (test copy; do not merge) ✨ Enhancement 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation 🕐 20-40 Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Add one-tap sharing of received files, with spaced downloads when batch sharing is unavailable.
>• Track completed handoffs to avoid duplicates and report files still arriving.
>• Add unit and browser coverage; this is a test copy, not for merge.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD BTN["Save all tap"] --> FILTER["Select received files"] --> READY{"Files ready?"} -->|Yes| COMPAT{"Batch share?"} -->|Yes| SHARE["Share sheet"] --> HANDED["Record handoffs"] --> TOAST["Status toast"] COMPAT -->|No or retry| DOWNLOAD["Spaced downloads"] --> HANDED READY -->|No| TOAST ```
High-Level Assessment

>The following are alternative approaches to this PR:
1. Package desktop files into one ZIP
- ➕ Provides one download instead of multiple browser downloads and prompts. - ➖ Adds packaging work and potentially substantial memory use for large files. - ➖ Changes the delivered format rather than downloading the original files individually.
>**Recommendation:** Keep the share-or-spaced-download approach for this test copy: it uses browser capabilities directly and preserves individual files without a packaging dependency. Review mobile sharing on real devices before considering a merge.

>Connect the Save all button to browser handoffs > >

>Select and save received files without repeat handoffs > >

Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (7)
1. Concurrent saves can duplicate a photo 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>save(p) adds a photo to saveAll.handed only after its share promise resolves, while
>createSaveAll.tap() does not coordinate with individual saves. If someone taps a print and then
>Save all while the first share is pending, both paths can select the same file; a second share may
>also reject because another share is in progress.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/index.html[327]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/140/files#diff-8f62b6ced28d3396b501d2e89a2e7cb761d16cd7dc977aebece03d4a5da5c24eR327-R327) > >```diff >+ if (navigator.canShare?.({ files: [file] })) navigator.share({ files: [file] }).then(() => saveAll.handed.add(p.pid), () => {}); >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >An individual share remains eligible for Save all while it is pending, and the two share calls can overlap. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/index.html[326-343] >- web/saveall.js[24-55] >## Recommended Fix >Use shared in-flight state for individual and batch saves. Reserve a photo while its share is pending, release it on cancellation or failure, and mark it handed only when the handoff can be established. Prevent overlapping native share operations without awaiting anything before a share launched from a tap. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/f6489e5c-63a7-4d11-a7a9-d84c2f22c2d2?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/f6489e5c-63a7-4d11-a7a9-d84c2f22c2d2)
2. Blocked downloads disappear from Save all 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>createSaveAll.tap() marks each PID handed as soon as download(file) returns, although
>downloadFile only clicks an anchor and receives no download outcome. When the browser blocks or
>denies successive automatic downloads, those files are excluded from later batches and the person is
>told there is nothing new to save.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R52-53]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/140/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR52-R53) > >```diff >+ if (i) await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP); >+ try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >An anchor click is treated as confirmed delivery even when the browser blocks a download. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[50-55] >- web/index.html[328-334] >## Recommended Fix >Do not permanently mark a file handed merely because its anchor click returned. Use a download flow with an explicit per-file confirmation or another observable outcome, keep unconfirmed files retryable, and tell the person when browser permissions may prevent successive downloads. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/2db77026-1a32-4168-94f4-038ad17971a2?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/2db77026-1a32-4168-94f4-038ad17971a2)

3. One share failure disables future sharing 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>createSaveAll.tap() sets downloadNext on a non-cancellation share error but never clears it
>after the next tap downloads the batch. A transient failure, including a concurrent-share rejection,
>therefore makes later Save all taps bypass an available share sheet for the rest of the tab session.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R44-45]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/140/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR44-R45) > >```diff >+ downloadNext = true; >+ return toast('Couldn’t open the share sheet. Tap Save all again to download'); >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >A failed share switches Save all to downloads permanently, rather than for the next tap. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[26-55] >- tests/saveall.test.mjs[102-115] >## Recommended Fix >Reset the fallback flag after the next download attempt completes, including when individual downloads fail. Test that a later batch attempts the share sheet again; keep cancellation distinct from a genuine share failure. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/379f6656-7cce-4db8-95bc-d5ec6dfaa819?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/379f6656-7cce-4db8-95bc-d5ec6dfaa819)

4. Failed batch downloads get no warning 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>createSaveAll.tap() catches a thrown download() call with only console.warn, after announcing
>that the whole batch is downloading. If object-URL creation or the anchor click throws for one file,
>the batch continues without telling the person which file needs another tap.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[53]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/140/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR53-R53) > >```diff >+ try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >Synchronous download failures appear only in the console while the batch toast implies all items were started. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[50-55] >## Recommended Fix >Count or identify failed download attempts and show a user-visible failure message after the batch, including how to retry. Retain failed PIDs for the next tap and keep console diagnostics. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/123ff591-c99b-43ab-bc04-67c660a12767?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/123ff591-c99b-43ab-bc04-67c660a12767)
5. Save all includes videos as well as photos 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>saveBatch checks ownership and prior handoff but never checks whether a received file is a photo.
>Since the picker accepts videos and received videos enter the same files map, Save all also shares
>or downloads them despite the photo-only Save all requirement.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R12-14]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/140/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR12-R14) > >```diff >+ for (const [pid, file] of files) { >+ const p = prints.get(pid); >+ if (p && p.owner !== me && !handed.has(pid)) ready.push({ pid, file }); >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >Save all selects received videos even though F13 limits the batch to received photos. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[10-18] >- tests/saveall.test.mjs[80-87] >## Recommended Fix >Filter batch entries using the received print's validated image type, and update the tests to establish that videos remain available through individual saving but do not enter the photo batch. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/b6246ce6-d482-43b7-ba77-22df2af08a34?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/b6246ce6-d482-43b7-ba77-22df2af08a34)
6. A pending share locks Save all indefinitely 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>createSaveAll.tap() sets busy before awaiting share(list) and clears it only when that promise
>settles. If the browser leaves the promise pending, every subsequent Save all tap returns “Still
>saving,” with no way to retry from the page.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R39-42]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/140/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR39-R42) > >```diff >+ busy = true; >+ try { >+ if (sharing) { >+ try { await share(list); } catch (e) { >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >A share promise that never settles keeps the Save all busy guard active indefinitely. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[32-55] >## Recommended Fix >Provide a timed, user-visible recovery path for a stalled share and allow an explicit subsequent tap to retry or choose downloads. Guard against a late settlement of the original promise changing state after recovery. Preserve the synchronous share call inside the original tap. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/4a3573d5-1767-46cf-9a3f-be6e90687387?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/4a3573d5-1767-46cf-9a3f-be6e90687387)
7. Cancelled Windows shares cannot be retried 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>createSaveAll.tap() treats fulfillment of navigator.share() as proof that every selected photo
>was handed over and adds all their PIDs to handed. On Windows the promise can resolve when the
>share popup opens, so dismissing that popup can leave every photo excluded from later Save all taps
>without a completed handoff.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R47-48]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/140/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR47-R48) > >```diff >+ for (const r of ready) handed.add(r.pid); >+ return toast(`Shared ${ready.length}${more(arriving)}`); >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >A fulfilled share promise does not establish delivery on every supported platform; on Windows it can mean only that the popup opened. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[41-48] >- web/index.html[326-328] >## Recommended Fix >Account for platform-specific share completion semantics before permanently excluding shared PIDs. Where delivery cannot be observed, provide an explicit way to retry or confirm the handoff rather than irrevocably treating popup launch as completion; apply the same policy to individual saves. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
